responsibility: Provides common selftest support and the top-level selftest runner for the analyzer subsystem. It contains small test utilities such as building synthetic global declarations and dispatches to the per-file analyzer selftest entry points for constraint management, program points and states, region modeling, and selected state machines when GCC is built with checking enabled.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable selftest support: it defines build_global_decl and the run_analyzer_selftests dispatcher that invokes the various per-component test families. Unlike analyzer-selftests.h, it is the central implementation and test runner.
